sentence: This project tries to find out which circulating autoantibodies are linked to breast cancer risk.
This project tests whether chemotherapy combined with repeated endoscopic ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation is safe and works in pancreatic cancer.
This project supports collaborative research on rare disease genomics by expanding and sharing datasets and discoveries.
This project uses cell-based high-throughput assays to predict what genetic variants of unknown significance do in muscular dystrophies.
This project studies how Staphylococcus aureus invades live cortical bone during osteomyelitis and looks for ways to stop it.
This project maps the connections between brain regions in the network linked to obsessive compulsive disorder.
This project builds a fiber-based speckle contrast optical spectroscopy system to measure brain activation in humans.
This project tries to improve prediction of pancreatic adenocarcinoma risk by combining genetic data with clinical factors.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms of brain senescence in different molecular subtypes of Alzheimer's Disease.
This project builds a smartphone tool that analyzes walking and balance to predict each older adult's risk of falls.
This project shares scientific data and results about cancer prevention and early detection with community members.
This project tries to find out how aging lowers survival in older adults with glioblastoma.
This project develops a drug for Sickle Cell Disease that destroys the off-switch of fetal hemoglobin to raise fetal hemoglobin levels.
This project tests cell membrane coated macroporous scaffolds as a way to help cranial bone regenerate.
This project develops approaches that make deep transformer networks more reliable for clinical natural language processing.
This project studies the ecology and control of Anopheles stephensi mosquitoes in the context of malaria.
This project develops compounds that target the Giardia lamblia proteasome to treat giardiasis.
This project supports analysis and visualization of single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics data.
This project tests what blood-borne neutrophils and monocytes do in experimental pediatric stroke.
This project studies how transposable elements shape gene expression in humans.
